headline: 《生化危机》领跑，新剧火线开播
summary: 今日影市由《生化危机：爆发夜》等热作领跑，《监狱雄心》《上海女儿》同场竞争；剧集方面《火线家族》《无间兄弟情》本周首播，《菜鸟老警》《权力的游戏前传：龙族》持续热播，待映《复仇者联盟5》与待播《幻视任务》受关注。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《生化危机：爆发夜》《监狱雄心》《上海女儿》等领跑今日/本周关注。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night, Prison Ambition, and Shanghai Daughter lead today's/weekly buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《火线家族》《无间兄弟情》本周开播，剧集市场竞争升温。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Fireline Family and Boundless Brotherhood debut this week, heating up series competition.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《权力的游戏前传：龙族》《梦魇绝镇》《黑色丽人》持续吸睛。
industryHighlights.en: Ongoing hits: The Rookie, Rick and Morty, House of the Dragon, From, and Black Beauty continue to draw attention.

industryHighlights.text: 待映/待播：《复仇者联盟5》《猫鼬》《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》及《幻视任务》等蓄势待发。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming: Avengers 5, Mongoose, Xian Ni Movie: Battle of Immortal Slaying, and Vision Quest are poised for release.

headlineEn: Resident Evil Leads, New Series Premieres
summaryEn: Today's film buzz is led by Resident Evil: Outbreak Night, with Prison Ambition and Shanghai Daughter competing; on TV, Fireline Family and Boundless Brotherhood premiere this week, while The Rookie and House of the Dragon remain hot, with Avengers 5 and Vision Quest upcoming.
